pages.text: $(italic)Mobile glass cannon. Maximum ranged damage. Paper-thin defenses. Don't get hit.$(/italic)$(br2)HP Modifier: -20%  |  Equipment HP: Half effectiveness$(br)$(bold)Weapon Affinities:$(/bold) Bows/crossbows (large bonus), melee (significant penalty)

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Eagle Eye$(/bold) — +30% projectile velocity, +20% accuracy, arrows travel 50% further.$(br2)$(bold)Predator's Mark$(/bold) — Ranged hit marks enemy for 8s: +10% damage from all sources (including allies). One mark at a time.$(br2)$(bold)Fleet-Footed$(/bold) — +12% speed. +20% speed for 3s after hitting a ranged attack. -20% speed for 3s when hit in melee.

pages.title: Passive Abilities (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Windborne$(/bold) — +20% damage while airborne, +10% damage while sprinting. -10% damage while standing still.$(br2)$(bold)Headhunter$(/bold) — +15% ranged crit chance, +25% ranged crit damage. Crits have 20% chance to refund the arrow.

pages.title: Active Ability
pages.text: Active: $(bold)Rain of Arrows$(/bold)$(br)Instantly fire 8 arrows in a spread. Each at 75% weapon damage. All arrows apply Predator's Mark. 40s cooldown.
